```artifact
Feature: Admin and Patient interactions with labs/pharmacy details, registration, profile updates, appointments, consultations, and prescriptions
  Scenario: Admin can edit labs/pharmacy details
    Given an admin user with access to labs/pharmacy management
    When the admin attempts to update or delete a lab/pharmacy record
    Then the system should reflect the changes made by the admin
    Examples:
      | lab/pharmacy record type | Expected outcome |
      | Update              | Changes applied |
      | Delete              | Record removed |

Feature: Patient can register
  Scenario: Patient registration process
    Given an empty registration system
    When a patient registers
    Then the system should register the patient
    Examples:
      | Patient details       | System state after registration |
      | Valid details        | Registration successful |
      | Invalid details     | Registration failure |

Feature: Patient can update their profile
  Scenario: Patient profile update
    Given a patient with an existing profile
    When the patient attempts to update their profile
    Then the system should reflect the updated profile
    Examples:
      | Profile field | New value | Expected system state |
      | Email        | newemail@example.com | Profile updated |
      | Address      | 123 New Address St. | Profile updated |

Feature: Patient can make appointments and submit online consultation requests
  Scenario: Patient makes an appointment
    Given a patient who wants to schedule an appointment
    When the patient selects a date and time
    And the requested slot is available
    Then the system should book the appointment
    Examples:
      | Date       | Time     | Appointment status |
      | 2023-04-01  | 10:00 AM | Booked |
      | 2023-04-02  | 3:00 PM   | Not booked |

Feature: Patient can view and generate prescription reports and invoices
  Scenario: Patient views prescription reports and generates invoices
    Given a patient with prescriptions
    When the patient requests a report and invoice
    Then the system should display accurate reports and invoices
    Examples:
      | Report type | Expected report details | Expected invoice details |
      | Prescription | Detailed prescription info | Accurate invoice with charges |

Feature: Doctor can provide consultation
  Scenario: Doctor provides consultation
    Given a patient consultation request
    When the doctor reviews the request
    Then the doctor should provide a consultation
    Examples:
      | Request type | Expected consultation outcome |
      | General Checkup | Comprehensive assessment |

Feature: Doctor can prescribe medicine
  Scenario: Doctor prescribes medicine
    Given a patient'se medical history
    When the doctor prescribes medication
    Then the prescription should be valid and retrievable
    Examples:
      | Medication | Expected prescription details |
      | Drug A     | Dosage, frequency, purpose |

Feature: Doctor can prescribe lab tests
  Scenario: Doctor prescribes lab tests
    Given a patient's medical need
    When the doctor prescribes lab tests
    Then the lab tests should be scheduled and retrievable
    Examples:
      | Test type   | Expected test details |
      | Blood Test  | Blood sample details |
